translations.web: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which Yahweh’s mouth will name.
translations.bsb: Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
translations.kjv: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
translations.asv: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory, and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of Jehovah shall name.
